description.text: Core courses Human Anatomy and Physiology, General Psychology, Social Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Pedagogical Psychology, Personality Psychology, Psychological Statistic and Software Application, Psychological Measurement, Experimental Psychology, Physiological Psychology, History of Psychology, Cognitive Psychology, Psychological Consultation, Research Methods in Psychology. Objective This objective is to train students to obtain solid theory, professional knowledge and techniques of psychology and related specialties. After graduation, students will be able to teach psychology or other related specialties in schools of various types. Students also can serve as professional personnel for mental health and psychological consultation. In addition, students can works as professional personnel in enterprises, public institutions, marketing departments or administration sections to do personnel selection, training, assessment and investigation as well as work as special personnel for psychological research and practice in other fields. Meanwhile, students are trained to lay for solid foundation for further advanced studies in psychological discipline and other relevant specialties. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education is granted

duration.text: The Primary Education at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
